newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: NatSteel Broadway offers 33.8 million shares.
newsitem.headline: NatSteel Broadway offers 33.8 million shares.

text.p: China-based NatSteel Broadway Ltd said on Thursday it was offering 33.8 million shares at US$0.70 each in an initial public offer (IPO).
NatSteel Broadway, which manufactures plastic and metal components for electronics products, said in a statement half the shares would be offered to the general public and half privately placed.

The shares are all new and represent 25 percent of the group's enlarged share capital of 134.8 million shares. The offer closes on October 8 and trading on a when-issued basis on the Stock Exchange of Singapore is expected to begin on October 10.
Proceeds of US$22 million will be used to further integrate operations through investments, redeem borrowings, buy new equipment, and as working capital.
